title: Canonicalize EKODIBIZ service hierarchy
approvalRef: Owner confirmation in ChatGPT conversation on 2026-09-03
reason: Unify the public EKODIBIZ hierarchy under /ekodibiz, publish Mall and Trade as child services, and remove the stale public /mall target that caused a production 404 while retaining compatibility redirects.

diff.summary: Change legacy domain targets for mall.ekodi.kr and mall.biz.ekodi.kr from https://ekodi.kr/mall to https://ekodi.kr/ekodibiz/mall, preserving the legacy domains only as compatibility entry points.

risks: Stale external links may continue to request the former /mall path.
A routing mismatch between the worker boundary and canonical registry could reintroduce a 404 or redirect loop.
Cached redirects may temporarily preserve an older route after deployment.
rollback: Revert the legacy-domain target mapping and canonical EKODIBIZ routing commit if production verification of /ekodibiz/mall, compatibility redirects, or worker-first routing fails.
